summary.text: Briar Bearss is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 97, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Jack Bader in a race without an incumbent.
Bearss served in the U.S. Army and works as an entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Bearss earned a high school diploma from Millington High School and a bachelor's degree from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point in 2022.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as an entrepreneur.
Bearss won the Republican primary on August 4, 2026, defeating Mark Piotrowski, 63.8 percent to 36.2 percent.
